<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Tank''' is the wall among the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes|classes]]. It has the best Defense scaling and a high Vitality scaling, its passive turns stamina regeneration into extra health regeneration, and it gains Training Points '''25%''' faster than average.
</translate>

<translate>
== Passive: Fortress == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
* '''50%''' of your stamina regeneration is granted as bonus '''health regeneration''' (it is a bonus, not a conversion).
* Healing you receive from passives or ally skills (not from eating) is '''+25%''' more effective.
* Below '''30%''' health, both bonuses are '''doubled'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting stats and regeneration == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
* '''Starting stats:''' RES 10 · VIT 10
* '''Regeneration''' (per 5 seconds): health 2.25 (+0.075 per VIT) · Ki 5.0 (+0.10 per ENE) · stamina 9.0 (+0.03375 per VIT, +0.045 per RES)
* '''TP gain ×1.25''': the Tank trains faster than average.
</translate>

<translate>
== Stat scaling == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
The Tank's standout scalings are '''Defense''' (DEF 0.384, the highest of all classes) and '''Vitality''' (2.5). The VIT and DEF values grow on a curve as you invest more, up to 4 times the starting rate. Compare every class on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes#Default stat scalings|Classes]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:12-->
</translate>
{{Config|Custom Races|stats.json}}
<translate>
<!--T:13-->
The class id is <code>tank</code>. Its passive values are <code>stmToHpRegenRatio</code> (0.5), <code>healingBonus</code> (0.25), <code>lowHpThreshold</code> (0.30) and <code>lowHpMultiplier</code> (2.0), set per race in <code>races/&lt;race&gt;/stats.json</code> together with the starting stats, scalings, regeneration and the TP gain multiplier.
</translate>
